name: Calendar Plugin
description: Official on-device calendar integration for scheduling and inspecting calendar events.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.7.0: Replaced byte-offset JSON and length-only command checks with full whitespace-tolerant JSON parsing and \uXXXX decoding, added JSON escaping for pipe-delimited commands, added /calendar help, fixed false-positive 'created' card detection, expanded memory to 16 pages with inputOffset/outputOffset, and unified English minimalist Chattree UI.

tools.description: Manage local device calendar events. Output ONLY a single valid JSON object with no extra text. For action='create', include 'title', 'start', 'startDate', 'end', 'endDate' (ISO-8601 24h format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss; default duration 60 minutes if unspecified) and 'duration'/'durationMinutes'. For listing upcoming events, output {"action":"events"}.

intentContract.description: Schedule or inspect device calendar events using exact ISO-8601 24-hour timestamps and duration.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action to perform: 'create' (schedule an event), 'events' (list upcoming events), or 'help' (show usage).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Concise event title without dates or times (required for action='create').

fields.name: start
fields.description: Start timestamp in 24-hour ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss) for action='create'.

fields.name: end
fields.description: End timestamp in 24-hour ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss), equal to start + duration (default 60 min).

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Duration in minutes as an integer (e.g. 15, 30, 45, 60, 120).

examples.input: meeting with John today at 3:30pm for 30 minutes
